sample_unit: patients (over one million in primary care data)

links.outcome: Discrimination and precision of CKD model on temporally later data versus original
links.effect: CKD AUC 89.2% vs 89.3% and average precision 22.1% vs 22.4% on the extended 2013-2022 temporal validation; no performance drop.
links.quote: The CKD model achieved largely consistent discrimination (AUC: 89.2% vs. 89.3%) and average precision (22.1% vs. 22.4%) using GA<sup>2</sup>M.

unlisted_practices: Reproducing published clinical prediction models on a modular analytics platform to verify reproducibility of results
Temporal external validation of prediction scores using primary care data

screen.reason: Empirical study testing the technical reproducibility and temporal external validation of three published clinical prediction models using an automated analytics validation engine (DIVE).

primary.practice: independent software platform replication and temporal revalidation
